overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn provided updates on city park renovations, heat wave emergency preparations, and the appointment of the city's next Poet Laureate.

items.title: Gillis Park Groundbreaking
items.summary: The city held a groundbreaking for a $1.4 million renovation project at Gillis Park that is expected to take up to 18 months to complete.

items.title: Park Infrastructure Updates
items.summary: A ribbon cutting for the Morrison Park tot lot is scheduled for August 7, with additional improvements underway at Carr, Cape Inn, and Hickey parks.

items.title: Heat Wave Cooling Centers
items.summary: In preparation for an upcoming heat wave, the Mayor designated the police station, the library, and the Senior Center as cooling centers with extended hours.

items.title: National Night Out
items.summary: The Medford Police Department will host its National Night Out event on August 1.

items.title: Poet Laureate Appointment
items.summary: Vinjaya Sundarum has been named the city's next Poet Laureate and will be officially installed on August 8.
